mapping.summary: Migrates data from Navision and Dynamics NAV to Business Central
claims: Migrates from Dynamics NAV 2009 R2 onwards to BC online and on-premises
Migrates from legacy SQL-based systems, not only NAV
Full and delta migration with change tracking for iterative migrations
Standard edition migrates ledger entries and posted and unposted documents
Light edition: master data and custom tables, image upload from local filesystem
Deluxe edition adds live-sync service and replication control
Ultimate edition supports parallel working in both systems with bidirectional sync
Prebuilt modules for master data, transactions, histories and document links
Audit trails, preview and validation before go-live
Data sources ODBC, CSV, REST API and user-defined
Runs locally, on an Azure VM or as Azure Container App
